description: This PHP script generates a pie chart visualization summarizing test plan execution results within the TestLink project. It includes code for configuration loading, data retrieval from test plan metrics, dataset creation for chart rendering, and drawing the pie chart with labels and colors. Additionally, it contains functions for initializing request arguments and checking user rights.

classes.name: pData
classes.description: Class from pChart library for managing dataset points and series.

classes.name: pChart
classes.description: Class from pChart library responsible for rendering pie charts and visual elements.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has the necessary rights to access test plan metrics.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and processes input parameters for the script, managing access rights and session states.
